source: WorldPop 2020 constrained age-sex rasters, 1 km (CC BY 4.0), clipped to Laguna (geoBoundaries ADM2/ADM3)
method: Adults 18+ = WorldPop 20+ bands plus 2/5 of the 15-19 band; each 1 km cell is assigned to an H3 cell and its municipality (border cells to the nearest polygon). Age-group shares spread each 5-year band evenly over its ages.
caveat: Modelled population estimates, not the PSA census. Coverage = checks / these adults.
